model: Bitcoin treasury NAV per share x exit mNAV at cost of equity (NAV/NTA route, hand-built)
valuation_model: Bitcoin treasury NAV per share x exit mNAV at cost of equity (NAV/NTA route, hand-built)

inputs.share_count_basis: 422.355m basic (402.714m class A + 19.640m class B, 10-Q cover, 25 Oct 2026) + 3.988m equity incentive awards (30 Sep 2026). Convertible notes and STRK are carried as senior claims at par, not as shares, because every conversion price is above the current price; each scenario re-tests conversion at its own year-5 NAV/share. The company's 'Assumed Diluted' 451.577m counts all converts as shares and is not used, because that would also require removing the debt.
inputs.share_growth_note: Held flat. Issuance at NAV is value-neutral per share; issuance above or below NAV is the nav_accretion driver. Charging share growth as well would double-count.
inputs.usd_assets_note: USD Reserve 4,830 + USD Cash 240 at 25 Oct 2026, after ~$701m of STRC repurchases since 30 Sep
inputs.net_debt_treatment: Convertible notes at par plus secured debt, less USD assets. Already deducted inside NAV, together with the preferred stack; never deduct again from an intrinsic value.
inputs.preferred_note: 30 Sep 2026 10-Q table, with STRC cut from 9,096 to ~8,390 for repurchases through 25 Oct. STRE is EUR 775m translated at the filing's rate.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income was immaterial (USD Reserve only established December 2025); 9M-2026 was 79.5m and is modelled as the yield on USD assets, not as owner FCF.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 10-K cash flow statement (XBRL), 53.369m; no equity-award tax withholding in FY2025
inputs.fcf_dcf_note: last_fcf is FY2025 owner FCF, recorded for the contract only. It is not a valuation input: the business has no cash flow base to discount.
inputs.buyback_note: No common repurchased under the $1.0bn authorization. ~$2.04bn of preferred was repurchased Jul-Oct 2026 and is reflected in the preferred stack.
inputs.balance_sheet_note: 30 Sep 2026 10-Q, rolled to the 25 Oct 2026 subsequent-period disclosures for bitcoin count, shares, STRC outstanding and USD assets.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity 13% in USD: ~4.3% risk-free plus a 5% equity risk premium on a beta of ~1.75, which is roughly bitcoin's long-run equity beta lifted for ~28% net senior claims against the bitcoin. MSTR's own measured beta is higher, but that volatility is what the three bitcoin paths already carry; the rate is the same in every scenario so risk is charged once. No WACC: the flow is to common, after interest and preferred dividends.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (~61m) sit inside the software business value; not deducted separately.
inputs.notes: MODEL: NAV/NTA + exit discount (dcf-methods routing row for LICs, investment trusts and closed-end funds), adapted for a leveraged single-asset bitcoin vehicle. An owner-FCF DCF is meaningless here: 99% of assets are bitcoin, which produces no cash flow, reported earnings are fair-value marks, and the software segment roughly breaks even after SBC. Value = year-5 see-through NAV per common share (bitcoin + USD assets + software, less convertible notes at par and preferred at liquidation preference, less half the deferred tax on gains over cost) x an exit P/NAV, discounted at the cost of equity. The software segment is valued separately at an EV/revenue multiple and summed. Expect the stock to gap at the next open; refresh both the stock price and inputs.btc_spot_price_usd together. Every intrinsic value moves roughly 1.4-1.5x any change in the bitcoin mark.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgement: base-case bitcoin price CAGR set equal to an unlevered required return on bitcoin (no-edge assumption); not derived from any historical CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (150.6% over five years; FY2022 equity was negative so no 3-year figure) is issuance, not retained earnings, and diverges from revenue (-0.1%) by far more than 30 points. EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative endpoints). None of the standard CAGRs describe this business; the relevant history is bitcoin per share.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (reported FCF less SBC) was negative in FY2024 and FY2025. SBC is ~11% of software revenue and exceeds software operating cash flow.

bear.growth_rates_note: bitcoin price growth per year from the spot mark (inputs.btc_spot_price_usd); there is no revenue growth path in this model
bear.exit_mnav_note: exit price as a multiple of see-through NAV per common share after all senior claims (equity P/NAV), not the company's EV-based mNAV
bear.nav_accretion_note: BTC-yield judgement: net accretion (+) or dilution (-) to common NAV/share from capital-markets activity, over and above the explicitly modelled carry
bear.wacc_note: cost of equity; the flow is post-interest and post-preferred, so no WACC and no net-debt deduction after discounting
bear.terminal_growth_note: not used: the terminal value is year-5 NAV x exit mNAV, not a Gordon perpetuity

scenario_narratives.bear: Bitcoin repeats a 2022-style drawdown and does not recover inside five years (about -8% a year, ending near $41k, two-thirds below the cycle high). The USD assets cover fixed charges into year 4; after that bitcoin is sold near the lows. Put convertibles are refinanced at ~10%. The stock trades at a 20% discount to NAV, as closed-end vehicles with negative carry and no accretive issuance window do, and equity issued below NAV costs a further 2% of NAV per share a year. Common equity survives but as a thin residual behind $20bn of senior claims.
scenario_narratives.base: Bitcoin appreciates 12% a year from the current mark, which is the no-edge assumption: an asset with no cash flows is fairly priced when its expected appreciation equals its required return. That puts it near $111k in late 2031, still below the prior cycle high. Fixed charges of ~$1.5bn a year run the USD assets down by year 4, then are met by bitcoin sales. Put convertibles are refinanced at ~6%. Capital-markets activity is neither accretive nor dilutive beyond that carry, and the stock exits at NAV.
scenario_narratives.bull: Bitcoin compounds 25% a year to about $192k (roughly 1.5x the prior cycle high). The premium to NAV returns (1.25x), which reopens accretive issuance worth 2% of NAV per share a year, and the four convertibles with strikes up to $233 are converted rather than repaid. This is the case the common is priced as an option on.

bear.fcf_note: No distributions to common are modelled (none are paid); all value is the year-5 exit. Fixed charges are paid from USD assets, then from bitcoin sales.

entry_price.methodology: Year-5 exit price (NAV/share x exit mNAV) discounted at the 15% hurdle instead of the 13% cost of equity. The exit is an explicit P/NAV judgement, so there is no Gordon term to rebuild at the hurdle.

required_return_table.note: Base year-5 exit price re-discounted at each rate; the 13% row is the base intrinsic value and the 15% row the base entry price.

sensitivity.methodology: Base-case drivers with only the bitcoin CAGR (rows) and the exit P/NAV (columns) changed; USD per share at a 13% cost of equity.
sensitivity.note: The usual WACC x terminal-growth grid does not apply; there is no perpetuity in this model.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: 30/45/25 rather than the 15/50/35 operating-company default. The bear is weighted up because the downside is structural rather than cyclical: ~$20bn of senior claims sit ahead of the common, ~$1.5bn a year of fixed charges has no operating cash flow behind it, BTC Yield has just turned negative, and the MSCI removal takes away a source of premium. The bull is held at 25% because it needs both a new bitcoin high and a restored premium.
probability_weighted.band_position_note: House and street bases coincide: SBC is not a driver of a NAV valuation (it sits inside the software multiple), so the band has collapsed.
probability_weighted.dispersion_note: The weighted value is an average of very different outcomes and the bull contributes most of it. The median outcome is the base case.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Strategy is a leveraged closed-end bitcoin vehicle with a small software business attached. The common is worth its share of the bitcoin after the convertible notes and five preferred series are paid, adjusted for what the vehicle does to that NAV over time: a carry cost of about 2.8% of the bitcoin a year, and capital-markets activity that adds to NAV per share only while the stock trades above it. No view on bitcoin's fair value is taken beyond the base case's no-edge assumption; the scenarios show what the capital structure does to the common under three bitcoin paths.
key_risks_to_valuation: The bitcoin mark: every value here moves about 1.4-1.5x a change in spot, and spot moved 8% between the stock's last close and this valuation.
Senior claims are fixed in dollars. Net of USD assets they are ~28% of the bitcoin at the current mark, and common NAV reaches zero at a bitcoin price near $17,200 before carry.
Fixed charges of ~$1.5bn a year must be met from USD assets (about 40 months of cover), new issuance or bitcoin sales. Below NAV, issuance is dilutive.
$6.75bn of convertibles are puttable between September 2027 and mid-2029, and every strike is above the current share price.
Deferred tax on bitcoin gains is recognised at 50%, which costs the base case about $3.83 a share today. Full recognition would deduct the same again; none would add it back.
The exit P/NAV is a judgement. The stock has traded from ~3.4x (late 2024) to about 1.1x now.
valuation_philosophy.deferred_tax_treatment: 21% on year-5 gains over the $75,437 average cost, recognised at 50%: a holder that never sells never pays, but the BTC Monetization Program now sells bitcoin and CAMT relief rests on interim guidance. No credit is taken for losses below cost.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular Friday close); 52-week range 81.81-213.83. Bitcoin from the same API (BTC-USD) at inputs.btc_spot_as_of.
data_sources.financials: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 (balance sheet, Note 6 debt, Note 10 preferred, MD&A capital structure and 25 October 2026 subsequent-period figures); FY2025 10-K; MSTR.duckdb kpis table for the bitcoin history.

refresh_instructions: A price-only refresh is not enough for this ticker. The stock price and inputs.btc_spot_price_usd must be refreshed together, and the scenario values recomputed, because the terminal bitcoin prices compound from the spot mark.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
